subject: Request: Vendor SLA & Support Onboarding Checklist for Redwood
messages:
From: Liam Hart <liam.hart@acme-retail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — SLA/support details needed

Hi Dylan,

We're kicking off vendor setup for Redwood on our side. Procurement needs a short SLA/support checklist and the contact/escalation matrix to move the PO and vendor-setup forward. Specifically they want:

- Primary and secondary support contacts (names, roles, direct lines)
- Escalation path for Sev 1/Sev 2 incidents
- Committed uptime/availability targets and maintenance window policy
- Response and resolution targets by severity
- Where to upload vendor docs and the vendor code (W-9, COI, bank details)

Can you send over a one-page checklist or the completed template? Also confirm whether Redwood requires a master services agreement signature or if the PO alone is sufficient for initial provisioning.

We'd like to have this by end of day tomorrow to keep our internal onboarding calendar on track.

Thanks,
Liam

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — SLA/support details needed

Thanks Dylan. Quick answers below — I also attached the draft support matrix and our standard SLA template (redwood_sla_template_v1.pdf, support_matrix_draft.xlsx).

Vendor setup / procurement artifacts (minimum for vendor record):
- Completed Vendor Onboarding Form (we'll ask Acme to complete)
- W-9 (or equivalent)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood as a certificate holder
- Bank remit details or payment instruction form (for ACH)
- Primary contact and invoice email for PO routing

MSA vs PO:
- For initial sandbox/proof-of-concept access we can onboard on PO + standard SOW/Order Form.
- For production, finance prefers a signed MSA + Order Form. We'll include the MSA as an optional DocuSign link if Acme wants it.

Support & SLA summary (high-level):
- Primary support contact (tier 1): Monica Patel — Support Operations Lead — monica.patel@redwood.com — +1 206-555-0185 (Mon-Fri 6am–6pm PT)
- Secondary on-call (tier 2): Marcus Lin — Site Reliability Manager — marcus.lin@redwood.com — +1 206-555-0112 (24/7 pager)
- Critical escalation (Sev 1): Naomi Feldman — Head of Support — naomi.feldman@redwood.com — +1 206-555-0100 (exec escalation line)

Escalation path (summary):
- Sev 1 (production outage impacting >20% of requests): contact tier 1 -> escalate to tier 2 within 15 minutes -> Naomi within 60 minutes if not mitigated.
- Sev 2 (degraded performance impacting a segment): contact tier 1 -> tier 2 response within 1 hour -> escalation to Naomi if broader impact within 4 hours.
- Response/resolution SLAs: initial response within 15 minutes for Sev 1, target mitigation/workaround within 2 hours, full resolution TBD by root cause. Sev 2 initial response within 1 hour, resolution target 24–72 hours depending on fix type.
- Uptime/availability target: 99.95% monthly for production endpoints (standard target). Planned maintenance windows will be scheduled and communicated at least 48 hours in advance; emergency maintenance may occur with on-call notification.

Attachments: redwood_sla_template_v1.pdf (one-page SLA summary), support_matrix_draft.xlsx (contact matrix and pager schedule).

Marcus: I flagged the finance PO routing requirements below — can you confirm the vendor code creation timeline and whether we need additional approvals for the first-month billing credit?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Support Operations Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Liam Hart <liam.hart@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — SLA/support details needed

Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a single-page checklist that consolidates what Acme needs to complete to get vendor setup and to confirm support coverage. Summary below and next steps: 

What we attached/are sending:
- Completed SLA summary (redwood_sla_template_v1.pdf) — includes uptime target (99.95%), response SLAs, and maintenance policy.
- Support contact matrix (support_matrix_draft.xlsx) — names, emails, phone/pager for Tier 1/2/exec.
- Vendor onboarding checklist (included in Google Doc link): what Acme should upload to their vendor portal (W-9, COI, remit info, completed vendor form).

PO & contracting notes:
- For initial access we can proceed with PO + Order Form. For production go-live, Finance will request a signed MSA + Order Form. If you want the MSA now we can send a DocuSign link (DocuSign: envelope-id-0a1b2c).
- Please route PO to finance@acme-retail.com and copy our procurement alias (procurement@redwood.com) so we can create the vendor record promptly. Our vendor code is created within 3–5 business days after we receive the completed vendor form and W-9.

Next steps and timeline:
1) Acme uploads vendor artifacts to the Google doc linked above (or emails them to procurement@redwood.com) — by end of day Friday, 12 Jun.
2) Redwood completes vendor setup (3–5 business days) and confirms vendor code.
3) If MSA required, sign via DocuSign; otherwise send PO and we’ll provision the dedicated environment.

If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the checklist with your procurement team.

Regards,
Dylan
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
